730c4427ddf02e94acce7201730c5c37.overview: In 1924, Oskar Matzerath is born in the Free City of Danzig. At age three, he falls down a flight of stairs and stops growing. In 1939, World War II breaks out.
730c4427ddf02e94acce7201730c5c37.tagline: A savage, sweeping epic of society in chaos.

731b5c1f3dc453f2e7400f1a94ae8835.overview: Amidst her own personality crisis, a southern housewife meets an outgoing old woman who tells her the story of Idgie Threadgoode and Ruth Jamison, two young women who experienced hardships and love in 1920s Whistle Stop, Alabama.
731b5c1f3dc453f2e7400f1a94ae8835.tagline: The secret of life? The secret's in the sauce.

7334d63bb18ad61883ab2ade6237c912.overview: Senator Walter Chalmers is aiming to take down mob boss Pete Ross with the help of testimony from the criminal's hothead brother Johnny, who is in protective custody in San Francisco under the watch of police lieutenant Frank Bullitt. When a pair of mob hitmen enter the scene, Bullitt follows their trail through a maze of complications and double-crosses. This thriller includes one of the most famous car chases ever filmed.
7334d63bb18ad61883ab2ade6237c912.tagline: The word 'cop' isn't written all over him—something more puzzling is.

733c8a89fb407dd1c9109e05ebeefec1.overview: Forcibly separated from her twin brother when they are orphaned, a melancholic misfit learns how to find confidence within herself amid the clutter of misfortunes and everyday life.
733c8a89fb407dd1c9109e05ebeefec1.tagline: Life can only be understood backwards, but we have to live it forwards.

734826f22161aa5f90306416ea4c7780.overview: Average American boy Chuck Murdock goes on a school outing to a nuclear weapons facility, where he learns about the destructive power that sits at the fingertips of the military. Knowing that the world could end with the push of a button, he protests against nuclear war by walking out on his Little League team during a game. Chuck's stunt ends up in the local paper, and as the story snowballs, basketball star "Amazing Grace" Smith decides to boycott sports, too.
734826f22161aa5f90306416ea4c7780.tagline: A boy raised a question, a man answered and the world paid attention.

736036ea46df4577a73478e0c4ab358b.overview: A look at the sexual and professional lives of three people — a television director, his ex-girlfriend, and a sex worker.

736f5a40d696f0e0182a47d90e1251bf.overview: In the continuing saga of the Corleone crime family, a young Vito Corleone grows up in Sicily and in 1910s New York. In the 1950s, Michael Corleone attempts to expand the family business into Las Vegas, Hollywood and Cuba.
736f5a40d696f0e0182a47d90e1251bf.tagline: The rise and fall of the Corleone empire.

7373ee62f56802ff764856ac0f42d8aa.overview: Women enter and exit a science fiction author's life over the course of a few years after the author loses the woman he considers his one true love.
7373ee62f56802ff764856ac0f42d8aa.tagline: Are you still in the mood for love?

738ba6d987b7caa9615381afd6e041ba.overview: When the seaside community of Amity finds itself under attack by a dangerous great white shark, the town's chief of police, a young marine biologist, and a grizzled shark hunter embark on a desperate quest to kill the beast before it strikes again.
738ba6d987b7caa9615381afd6e041ba.tagline: The terrifying motion picture from the terrifying No. 1 best seller.

738c78d2245bf7d47b8a7e1303cfe147.overview: A taxi dancer with a jealous husband finds herself falling for a wealthy client.
738c78d2245bf7d47b8a7e1303cfe147.tagline: SHE WAS A DANCE HALL HOSTESS BUT THE BAND NEVER PLAYED "HOME SWEET HOME" FOR HER

738f79ea08ad9352d808c25a701683b5.overview: A disillusioned college graduate finds himself torn between his older lover and her daughter.
738f79ea08ad9352d808c25a701683b5.tagline: This is Benjamin. He’s a little worried about his future.

73a51b2c76d29f354769538da1fc0939.overview: A young businessman goes to a magic expert to learn hardness and skill with his cynical and greedy collaborators. He becomes a very good tap dancer, but will he be able to get free of his old boss?
73a51b2c76d29f354769538da1fc0939.tagline: Donald Beeman was a top executive with a $9,000 sports car, a penthouse, and a terrific blonde...Then he found happiness.

73d6f561d896d68b6c56e7739ed6258c.overview: In 1900, young widow Lucy Muir learns that her seaside cottage is haunted and forms a unique relationship with the ghost.
73d6f561d896d68b6c56e7739ed6258c.tagline: THE SPIRIT... so willing! THE FLESH... so weak! THE ROMANCE... so wonderful!

73dabd60c23b9d6614c3a8bcb6379be0.overview: A $10-million diamond rip-off, a stolen identity, a new life married to a diplomat. Laure Ash has risked big, won big. But then a tabloid shutterbug snaps her picture in Paris, and suddenly, enemies from Laure's secret past know who and where she is. And they all want their share of the diamond heist. Or her life. Or both.
73dabd60c23b9d6614c3a8bcb6379be0.tagline: Nothing is more desirable or more deadly than a woman with a secret.
